body_markdown:
The 2026 BMI R&B/Hip-Hop Awards were held last night, with Khris Riddick-Tynes‘ hit collaboration “Folded” by Kehlani taking home an award for ‘Most Performed Songs of the Year.’


“Yukon” by Justin Bieber, co-written by ASCAP writer 2 Chainz, was also recognized as one of the Most Performed Songs of the Year.


For more on the awards, visit BMI’s award[page](https://awards.bmi.com/show/rnb-2026) .
